askAt.description:
---- the refill ask -------------------------------------------------------------------
When a tab has this many unseen entries left (or fewer), ONE notification asks
"Only 5 Discover entries left -- process 30 new ones now?". Answering runs a batch.
Default 5; a whole number, 0 .. 1000.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 1000. Default: 5.

batchSize.description:
How many new entries one batch processes. Default 30; a whole number, 1 .. 200.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 200. Default: 30.

rolloverHour.description:
---- the day --------------------------------------------------------------------------
The wiki day rolls at this local hour. An article nobody saw carries over. Default 4; a whole number, 0 .. 12.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 12. Default: 4.

seenMs.description:
---- what counts as attention (milliseconds) ---------------------------------------
Read this long in the wiki detail (the clock popup's, opened by you) = seen: it is replaced at the next
rollover and never shown again. Each tab on its own; a glance elsewhere never counts. Default 5000; 0 .. 600000.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 600000. Default: 5000.

dwellMs.description:
The pointer over the card this long = a weak "I like this" (once per card). Default 15000; 1000 .. 3600000.

Takes a whole number 1000 .. 3600000. Default: 15000.

quickNextMs.description:
"Next" before this long on a card = a weak "not this" (quick next). Default 4000; 0 .. 600000.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 600000. Default: 4000.

ollamaUrl.description:
---- the tool (passed to tools/wiki/wiki.py in its environment) --------------------
The local Ollama that judges and writes when Jev is off or unavailable; the shell's GPU helper watches it too while the LLM's
server is not this machine's. Default "http://localhost:11434"; an http:// or https:// URL.

Takes a text like http://localhost:11434. Default: "http://localhost:11434".

jev.description:
Jev (Defapi) locates and scores intros. false = the local model does it all. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

jevKey.description:
Jev's API key (Defapi, "dk-..."). Empty: no Jev, the local model does it all. Default "" (a secret: never printed).

Takes a text. Default: "".

notesRoot.description:
---- save to note -----------------------------------------------------------------------
Save-to-note writes <notesRoot>/<notesFolder>/<title>.md. notesRoot: a path ("~/" is the home). Default "~/Documents/Notes".

Takes a path. Default: "~/Documents/Notes".

notesFolder.description:
One plain folder name (no "/", not "." or ".."). Default "Wiki".

Takes a text like Wiki. Default: "Wiki".

calendar.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

notifications.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

lock.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

launcher.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

show.description:
---- where the card is ------------------------------------------------------------------
On the calendar, in an empty notification manager, on the lock screen, under the launcher's search. Each is true or false; default true.

families.description:
---- subjects ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
A subject that is false is never picked and never fetched (what is in the pool stays there). Discover: history geography people visual-arts
performing-arts literature philosophy society physical-sciences life-sciences earth technology everyday. Deepen: arch-installed
arch-discovery wikipedia-cs arch-tips other-wikis. For example { "people": false }.

Default: {}.

askAgainHours.description:
---- the batches -------------------------------------------------------------------------
"Later" on the refill ask is asked again after this many hours. Default 24; 1 .. 720.

Takes a number 1 .. 720. Default: 24.

jevCapUsd.description:
What one batch may cost at Jev, US dollars. Default 0.04; 0 .. 10.

Takes a number 0 .. 10. Default: 0.04.

models.description:
The local models that write and judge ("" = the ones tools/wiki/data/models.json names; a judge it has no thresholds for takes its
"default" ones).

wikipedia.description:
Discover, and Deepen's Wikipedia computing

Takes true or false. Default: true.

arch.description:
the Arch wiki: pages of what you have installed and what you have not

Takes true or false. Default: true.

archTips.description:
the "Tips and tricks" sections of installed software's Arch pages (only with "arch")

Takes true or false. Default: true.

gentoo.description:
wiki.gentoo.org

Takes true or false. Default: true.

kernel.description:
docs.kernel.org

Takes true or false. Default: true.

freedesktop.description:
the freedesktop.org specifications

Takes true or false. Default: true.

sources.description:
---- sources ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Switch a source off and its families leave the batch plan (entries already in the
pool stay). Discover is Wikipedia; Deepen is the rest. Each is true or false; default true.
